ratings.notes: Direct animal evidence (iCftr KO) clearly supports CFTR loss induces dysbiosis and inflammation. Multiple PMIDs confirm epithelial-specific mechanism. Strong mechanistic foundation.

Claim specifies NF-κB mechanistic link, but supplied path evidence only shows CFTR→inflammation without NF-κB intermediate. PMID 27588407 cited but quote absent from path. Requires explicit NF-κB evidence.
Claims multi-hop (CFTR→dysbiosis→inflammation) but path evidence only shows CFTR→dysbiosis. Second hop (dysbiosis→inflammation) lacks explicit supporting quote and PMID linkage in provided evidence.
Claim adds specific mechanistic detail (SCFA depletion, Bacteroides loss, propionate) not present in supplied path evidence. PMID 38179971 cited but no supporting quote provided. Unsupported novelty.
Epithelial-specific sufficiency claim directly supported by iCftr KO evidence. Quotes explicitly state epithelial-specific loss is sufficient. Strong mechanistic and translational value.
